title: Haldi relief read as a spearhead; sites called fortresses (kalesi)
summary: Matt tells of Haldi relief read as a spearhead; sites called fortresses (kalesi), about Urartian era at Lake Van region, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: warlike they believe archaeologists believe firmly that what they're passing in their hand is a spearhead

plain: A researcher named Matt, on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2024, describes a carved image of the god Haldi from the Lake Van area of Turkey, made by the ancient people known as the Urartians, in which an object is being passed from a hand. He says archaeologists firmly believe the object is a spearhead and see the culture as warlike, calling its sites kalesi, a Turkish word for fortresses. He suggests that reading may be mistaken, which would change what these ancient sites were for.
